notes.title: Noxia Somnia Update v1.1
notes.notes:
We've got a new update releasing today for Noxia Somnia, the biggest one being adding a new language: French!

📜 Text

- The game's text system has been completely reworked from the ground up. Improved performance, support for multiple languages, and more.
- New Language: French! The language menu can be opened on the title screen, and players can now pick between English and French. Additional languages will be added in future updates.
- When playing with French language, guillemets should be used consistently instead of quotation marks.
- A large amount of dialogue has been rewritten so that it flows more naturally, and has a bit more personality. Robotic sounding lines have been removed or reworked. These rewrites affect the entire game.
- Some tutorials and button text have been simplified so that they are more understandable at a glance.
- All instances of text overlapping other menu icons have been resolved.



🐛 Resolved Bugs

- Major Bugfix; Certain text elements no longer duplicate when you die or reload the game.
- All instances of the "There is an item ahead!" debug text loading for tutorials have been fixed.
- The player can no longer turn the flashlight on and off when in the skill tree menu, this should prevent any instances of controls locking up due to bugged animation states.
- Any instances where the skill tree menu broke and could not be used should be fixed now.
- The save file delete menu no longer uses the UI from the pre-alpha builds of Noxia. (How did this even happen?)
- Rare item popup missing text bug fixed.



📢 Audio & Music

- When the game is paused, the player's heartbeat sound is reduced in volume. This should make it less annoying when inputting safe codes, reading, or browsing your inventory.
- Rain on roof ambience in the hub world now scale based on your "Effects" volume setting instead of blasting at max volume when the game is muted.
- Final boss ambience and other sound effects now scale based on sound effect volume setting.
- The song "Chez Pierre" now scales based on music volume.



⚙️ Optimization

- Heartbeat monitor code optimized. It probably doesn't need to update every single frame, right?
- Event Checks & Room Detection no longer run on fixed time for slightly improved performance.



🎨 Graphical Adjustments & Fixes

- A variety of decorations in Act 1 and 2 were improved.
- Appearance of the Culinary Room in Act 1 was changed.
- Some minor adjustments were made to the final boss's visuals. This includes overhauled lighting, new warning indicators for their slam attack, and indicators for when the shield around their heart is vulnerable.



⚖️ Balance Adjustments

- The health of the final boss was reduced by roughly 40% on all modes to reduce the difficulty of the battle.
- The final boss's claw slam attack now deals a set amount of damage rather than each hand doing a specific amount of damage.
- The final boss no longer summons Shades of Life or Bullies.



🎮 Controls

- Custom keybinds have been replaced with a more complex and easy to use preset system. This change was made in the minor patch 1.0.2, and has been improved for 1.1's release.
- Applying control presets is now done automatically when exiting the menu instead of having to manually select "apply" after picking your preset.
- If an input device disconnects during gameplay, the game will now automatically pause. 



💻 UI

- The settings menu has been redesigned. It now looks a lot better, and text within the menu has been simplified so it is easier to understand.
- The game mode select screen was simplified a bit.
- The control menu was simplified a bit as well.
- On 16:10 / Steam Deck handheld mode, tutorial prompts on the skill tree are no longer offscreen.
- Text on the skill tree is no longer cut off by the (invisible) preview video for skills.
- The phone pause screen now scales correctly on 16:10 and 21:9 ultrawide resolutions.
- Collectable display UI now starts at it's default position when opening a menu instead of being scrolled down slightly.



💀 Known Issues

- There is a known bug with input devices where you cannot connect one mid-game. If you are having trouble connecting a controller, try connecting it prior to launching the game and making sure it does not disconnect during loading screens. This will be a priority fix for next update.
- During Pierre's introduction scene, one of his dialogue boxes incorrectly is displayed over Tristan.
- There may be issues with certain lines of text in this update due to the extensive changes made to the text system, please let us know if you find any.



Thanks for the support and for playing Noxia Somnia!

notes.title: Update: Demo Build V4!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43487169/4e977c06da52aa647661b99ffdea18a690c2d8f6.png[/img]

New version update today thanks to all our play testers! 
 
🐛 Resolved Bugs
[list]
[*] Cafeteria scene in the intro should no longer be blurred/obscured when returning after dying or reloading the game.
[*] The item in the safe in the kitchen will no longer render behind the safe when opened.
[*] The entrance to the school area in the intro will no longer despawn if you die to Overwhelming Anxiety.
[*] Increased Tristan's worker sprite by 1 pixel on the Y axis so that he no longer clips into the floor.
[/list]

💪 Improvements
[list]
[*] All UI properly scales and works on Steam Deck. ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Checkpoints in the intro are now properly shown to the player through "damaged portals" placed in the prologue.
[*] Player can now use multiple items at once in the inventory without it closing each time.
[*] If the player is not carrying any items, there is now text for empty inventory.
[*] Using the flashlight from the inventory will toggle it in-game to avoid confusion.
[*] Save notification now says "PROGRESS SAVED."
[*] Added a brief interactable cinematic near the end of the chase that happens in the intro.
[*] Hallway that you are chased through in the intro has more decorations now.
[*] Visuals in second half of Act 1 were improved significantly.
[*] Added a prompt that indicates when a character is finished talking.
[*] Player can now attack in "cinematic" areas. (Not sure why we restricted attacking in these areas anyway, it was causing some confusion among play testers and you can't really break anything in these areas anyway...)
[*] Flashback scene that occurs after the first real boss no longer lets you walk to the right
[*] Graduate fireball was rebalanced. SFX was changed when they hit the ground, added VFX for spawning and de-spawning as well as a warning line to indicate trajectory.
[*] Textbox shading was improved
[/list]

📜 Text Changes
[list]
[*] Unlock condition for Ultimate Nightmare was changed from "complete on normal" to "Complete demo on "The Nightmare" mode".
[*] Ghost 1 in the intro now has 3 question marks to be consistent with Ghost 2.
[*] Interact tutorial text has been changed to be less confusing.
[*] You can interact with the door at the end of the first hallway in the prologue now.
[*] Fixed some typos on the descriptions in the settings menu. Added a note about screen tearing when not using VSync in full screen.
[*] Very minor changes to dialogue throughout the demo area (make some wording less confusing)
[*] Taser short circuiting is now mentioned in the taser tutorial so people aren't as confused by it.
[/list]

⚖️ Balance Adjustments
[list]
[*] Graduate boss fight has been extensively rebalanced across all modes. (Mostly easier.)
[*] The Graduate's tornado attack has been temporarily removed.
[*] The Nightmare has been made easier. (Taken damage is reduced by 20% across the board. Certain enemies are slower.)
[*] Face Your Fears, Graduate's attacks are now slower.
[*] Ultimate Nightmare boss fights made significantly harder. (New attacks, much higher speed...)
[/list]


If you would like to join the community our discord: https://discord.gg/63HnCSrA

notes.title: Update: Demo Build V3!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43487169/5875057da8413eb8e418e881dd71f3a39656cc71.png[/img]

New version update today thanks to all our play testers! 
 
⚖️ Overall Balance Adjustments
•	Drop rates for common monster items were increased. (30% > 80%)
•	The "Bully" enemy type now has a rare item drop. (Medkit, about a 10% chance.)
•	The range on all weapons has been buffed by about 15%.
•	Flashlight heals stress faster on all modes.
•	The first boss now drops Experience Shards and Coins when killed.
•	Helpful items have been placed around Act 1, and some existing items have been relocated.
•	Consumable invulnerability window has been reduced. (0.5s > 0.3s)
•	Default stamina recharge rate increased by 5/s on all modes.
•	Stress healing base value is increased by roughly 5-10% to make stress management easier.
•	The clocks for the "Time Is Key" puzzle now glow.
•	Hitting crates with melee weapons is no longer framerate dependent. 

🔦 Face Your Fears Adjustments
•	Stress heals an additional 10% faster on Face Your Fears.
👿 Nightmare Mode Adjustments
•	Player takes 20% less damage on Nightmare now.
💀 Ultimate Nightmare Mode Adjustments
•	Player takes 275% damage now instead of 250%.
•	IFrames reduced from 0.2s to 0.15s.
•	Stress heals an additional 10% faster on Ultimate Nightmare.

🐛 Resolved Bugs
•	Soul of Recovery is now working as intended.
•	Calm Mind I will no longer increase the stress that the player takes.
•	Fixed an incorrect prompt in the key bind menu.
•	Most menus now work on 16:10 aspect ratio.
•	At 200+ FPS, hitting crates with melee weapons should be more consistent. 
•	Graduate can no longer be despawned in the first part of Act 1 by going through specific doors.
•	The Graduate will no longer cancel entering a door due to Level 2 Exposure Status.
•	Additionally, the "close door" sound for the AI is much more obvious now.
•	The Graduate's AI is improved and they will no longer camp the Teacher's Lounge.
•	Summons (Greg, Scholar) will no longer attack enemies while they should be frozen.
•	Soul of Vigor will no longer provide health regeneration when interacting with objects.
•	Summon: Scholar can now hit moving enemies more consistently.
•	Player can now pet the Greg summon.
•	Tristan's movement speed calculation with certain skills was incorrect, and has been fixed.

 🎨 Graphical Adjustments & Fixes
•	Floating tutorial keyboard prompts now fade out.
•	Sprite masking error in intro forest has been fixed.
•	Using the taser now short circuits the flashlight for a few seconds.
•	HUD improved. 
•	Act 1 decorative objects improved. (Science Lab cabinets, tables, sink,  speakers, etc.)
•	Lamps can be toggled on and off by interacting with them.
•	Visual indicator has been added for taser charge.
•	Taser will not charge or play the sound when you do not have the taser module in your inventory.
•	Exposure Gauge, Settings menu now have animations for entry.
•	Safe has full SFX, as well as prompts now.
•	New red glow near the exposure meter that indicates how close the monster is to the player.
•	Stress is much more obvious now (There is a glow from the HUD that intensifies as stress increases. At 50%, it prompts to enable the flashlight)
•	Collectables and Soul pickups are now much more obvious. (They appear as a larger, separate notification with the ability for the player to hold inventory to show the menu they are in.)
•	Interact prompts now have some animations for fading in.
•	Added a prompt on the main menu.
•	Tristan has a new effect for when the taser is charged.

📜 Text
•	The voices that talk while Tristan is unconscious in the first scene now have voices.
•	When the teacher is transforming into The Graduate, their name now changes as intended.
•	Tutorial in Act 1 adjusted, player is no longer told to upgrade before they unlock the ability to.
•	A reminder about turning off the light to attack has been added outside the school.
•	Added a tutorial about the different types of item pickups in the intro.
•	Weird pause in the Prologue's cafeteria scene fixed.
•	Guide not spawning before talking in acrobat soul scene fixed.
•	"Death" changed to "Regret"
•	"Miscellaneous" changed to "Other"
•	A lot of collectables have been rewritten. (Bloodstained Note, Old Essay, Worn Scissors, etc.)
•	More scenes, and a significant amount of dialogue, have changed in Ultimate Nightmare mode.
•	Ultimate Nightmare no longer tells the player that fighting the patrolling monster is an option.
•	Some text color changed from Dark Blue to Light Blue to be more readable.

🎸 Music
•	The song "The Occulted Ones" now plays during the first boss fight in Act 1.

🏫 Level Design
•	Merchant now sells "School Safe Codes", and safes have been added that contain helpful items.
•	You can now interact with most of the lamps in the intro. 💡
